headline: Quest Diagnostics (DGX) Stock May Be 32% Undervalued As Guidance Rises
summary: Quest Diagnostics stock has climbed strongly over the past few years, yet current valuation checks suggest the shares may still trade below an estimate of intrinsic value based on a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) approach. Quest Diagnostics has returned 83.7% over the past 3 years, which means anyone who held through that period already saw a substantial gain and now needs to judge how much value is left in the current price.
